landing.meta_description: Book in seconds with your favorite merchants. No more waiting in line.
landing.hero_subtitle: Book in seconds with your favorite merchants. Show up, it's ready.
landing.service_desc: Our first service lets you book your car wash slot online. Pick your time, pay securely, and show up when it's your turn. No more waiting in line.
landing.how_subtitle: Three steps to never wait again
landing.step_1_desc: Browse professionals near you. Check reviews, prices and availability at a glance.
landing.step_2_desc: Pick the time that works for you and pay online securely via Stripe.
landing.step_3_desc: No more lines. Your spot is reserved, your time is saved.
landing.features_subtitle: Every feature is designed to save you time
landing.feat_realtime_desc: See open slots instantly. No need to call or show up to check.
landing.feat_payment_desc: Pay online by card via Stripe. Fast, reliable and 100% protected.
landing.feat_notif_desc: Get a reminder before your slot. Zero risk of forgetting or being late.
landing.feat_rating_desc: Read ratings from real customers before making your choice.
landing.testimonial_1_text: I never wait in line anymore. I book my slot in 30 seconds from my couch.
landing.testimonial_2_text: Clean interface, fast booking. The notification reminder is a real game-changer.
landing.testimonial_3_text: Discovered Slowtime for car wash and now I can't wait for the next services to launch.
landing.merchant_subtitle: Join Slowtime and grow your business. Manage your slots, track your revenue and retain your customers.
landing.final_cta_subtitle: Join the users who never wait in line.
